# module path mapping

File system paths map to dotted module ids by splitting on '/', dropping empty parts, and removing a trailing 'index' segment; the resulting parts are joined with '.'

Provide a deterministic mapping from source file paths to module identifiers so emitted facts use a consistent component path.
